craft_notes: Sthāyin: karuṇa-vīra of all-folk grace; vyabhicāri karuṇotsāha at darkness allayed for all. Sanskrit-first: stotra-bandha (PRAISE-BONDS — kept; bonds of praise heard); prasāda-āgamana (IF-GRACE-COMES — kept conditional); sarva-jana (ALL-FOLK — kept; outward turn kept). Rows: 7 (Lord addressed mid-verse — grace asked TO him), 1 (‘darkness allayed’ closes — allayed last, for all). Close: ‘make all folk, darkness allayed’. Rupture: em-dash (heard stated, then asked — bonds heard, grace prayed). Rejected: closing inward — killed: outward IS the turn (karuṇa turns to all-folk); ‘swiftly’ smoothing — killed: āśu kept quickly. Read aloud: THUS — THESE-praise-BONDS OF-your-POW-er's RAY-mass HEARD — LORD, IF-grace-COMES — … QUICK-ly BY-your-RULE-rays MAKE-all-FOLK, DARK-ness al-LAYED.

lines: Thus — these praise-bonds of Your power's ray-mass heard — Lord, if grace comes —
quickly by Your rule-rays make all folk, darkness allayed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ svaśaktikiraṇaughanutiprabandhān ākarṇya | nijaśāsanāṃśu saṃśāntitākhilatamaḥpaṭalāṃ vidheyāḥ

reads_against.argmap: What grace is asked? → Heard praise-bonds; grace prayed; all-folk darkness-allayed bidden.
c1_essence: Heard bonds; grace coming; all-folk bidden allayed.
